settings.codeforcesWorkbench.cpp.templateCode: Initial C++ code for new solutions. Supports ${PROBLEM_ID}. Empty uses the template file or built-in default. Existing code is never overwritten.
settings.codeforcesWorkbench.python.templateCode: Initial Python code for new solutions. Supports ${PROBLEM_ID}. Empty uses the template file or built-in default. Existing code is never overwritten.
settings.codeforcesWorkbench.ui.language: AC-Stride interface language. Does not translate problem statements or code.
settings.codeforcesWorkbench.codeforces.handle: Optional public read-only Codeforces handle for submission results and nearby ranking. No account authentication is performed.
settings.codeforcesWorkbench.python.interpreter: Python 3 executable or absolute path. On Windows you may need to set this to python. For virtual environments, use the interpreter's full path.
settings.codeforcesWorkbench.python.args: Additional Python interpreter arguments. AC-Stride adds unbuffered UTF-8 execution flags.
settings.codeforcesWorkbench.python.templatePath: Optional absolute path to a Python template; supports ${PROBLEM_ID}.
settings.codeforcesWorkbench.cpp.compiler: C++ compiler executable or absolute path.
settings.codeforcesWorkbench.cpp.args: Compiler arguments, passed without a shell.
settings.codeforcesWorkbench.cpp.templatePath: Optional absolute path to a C++ template; supports ${PROBLEM_ID}.
settings.codeforcesWorkbench.solution.defaultLang: Default programming language for newly imported contests, Codeforces problems and local practice.
settings.codeforcesWorkbench.java.templatePath: Optional absolute path to a Java template; supports ${PROBLEM_ID}.
settings.codeforcesWorkbench.java.templateCode: Initial Java code for new solutions. Supports ${PROBLEM_ID}. Empty uses the template file or built-in default. Existing code is never overwritten.
settings.codeforcesWorkbench.kotlin.templatePath: Optional absolute path to a Kotlin template; supports ${PROBLEM_ID}.
settings.codeforcesWorkbench.kotlin.templateCode: Initial Kotlin code for new solutions. Supports ${PROBLEM_ID}. Empty uses the template file or built-in default. Existing code is never overwritten.
